device.basis: Coordinate table of the X-T20 2.11 section-5 imaging driver (0xc3c100..0xc3f8c4, beside the block at 0xfff3b000), one page of four (0xfff3f000..0xfff42fff). 0xc3d2c8 writes one word per entry of a list of at most 0x1000 entries to 0xfff3f200 + 4*n: two 13-bit coordinates in bits 0-12 and 16-28, each offset by a word of the list header, with two flag bits each (13-14, 29-30). It then reads the last word back and sets its bit 31; an empty list writes 0x1fff/0x1fff with bit 31 to +0x200 and +0x204. The list comes from the body's flash data: a strict boot with a camera's own flash regions writes +0x200 at 162.9M instructions, while the update image's defaults do not reach it before REC. The words read back their last write; what the table does is not modeled.
